$description: Values are authored as CSS strings inside DTCG structure, not as DTCG structured color, dimension or duration objects. Style Dictionary 5.5.2 mangles every structured form this contract needs, so $type here is descriptive metadata and the string is the authored value. See ops/token-contract.md, section "Why the source authors CSS strings inside DTCG structure".

tap.$description:
The one length authored as a physical-size guarantee: a target floor is
a promise about a fingertip and must not shrink with the root font size.
Applies on BOTH axes. The shape and stroke values are px as well, as
fixed geometry rather than as a guarantee. No reader-scaled length is px:
not the type scale, not the spacing scale, not the measure.
See DESIGN.md § The hit-target floor.
